item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00080","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C24","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.79,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied a material template for advocating congressional support for a major power project. Both letters first identify the requested congressional action, explain the project's ordinary peacetime and economic value, then emphasize that power capacity is also needed for national security and emergencies, and conclude with a strong recommendation or urging to Congress. That combined argumentative sequence and the adapted peace/emergency language are more concrete than a merely shared infrastructure topic. C24 and C12 concern security-related funding or construction, but their machinery and phrasing are less closely aligned with the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The New Johnsonville plant is needed to provide a minimum reserve capacity for supplying firm power ... assuming a normal peacetime growth of demand, and it is urgently needed ... in the event of an emergency affecting the national security.","parent_excerpt":"The transportation system and the power facilities which the St. Lawrence offers ... will ... provide in particular cheap water power and water transportation facilities needed in peace as well as in a time of emergency.","explanation":"Both frame expanded power capacity as serving ordinary peacetime needs and emergency or national-security needs."},{"child_excerpt":"I urge, in the strongest possible terms, the favorable consideration of your Committee and of the Congress.","parent_excerpt":"I therefore strongly recommend that the Congress enact legislation authorizing this great undertaking.","explanation":"Both culminate in an emphatic request for favorable congressional action on the power project."},{"child_excerpt":"There is no equally effective means of assuring to the nation the prompt installation of this new capacity","parent_excerpt":"the St. Lawrence Seaway must be developed if we as a Nation are to continue to receive the fullest benefits from our natural resources","explanation":"Each presents the specified infrastructure project as necessary to secure national benefits rather than as one interchangeable option."}]}
